Bring the boiling water and bicarbonate of soda to a simmer.Boil the bites in batches for 20 seconds, then drain on baking paper.Bake at 220°C until deep golden, then brush with melted butter and coarse salt.For the dip, melt butter, stir in the remaining flour, whisk in the milk and simmer.
